name: Swell Palm
description: Lift water qi from the legs in a slow swell and break it against the target's chest through an open palm.

name: Crest Guard
description: Raise a curved crest of water qi before the body so a blow rides up it and loses its weight.

name: Rising Step
description: Rise on the front foot as the swell lifts and cross a pace of ground in one smooth gain.

name: Rill Mend
description: Trace a thin rill of water qi down an ally's wounded limb to ease the pain and draw the torn edges together.

name: Swell Knock
description: Knock on the target's guard arm with the knuckles as the swell peaks so the force passes through it.

name: Breaking Swell
description: Let a gathered swell of water qi break against the opponent so the blow lands and the stance is shoved apart.

name: Lifting Swell
description: Ride an incoming strike up on a swell of qi and leave the line of attack with the body lifted aside.

name: Cord Wrap
description: Throw a cord of water qi round the opponent's wrist and pull it snug against the body.

name: Slip Eddy
description: Slip sideways into a small eddy of qi that spins the body away from a grasping hand.

name: Ribbon Strike
description: Whip a ribbon of water qi from the palm so it curls past the guard and slaps the cheek.

name: Knot Guard
description: Tie a quick knot of qi round an attacking arm and swing it aside before the knot slips.

name: Tangle Pull
description: Tangle the opponent's ankles in strands of water qi and pull so the weight shifts the wrong way.

name: Rivulet Mend
description: Send a rivulet of healing water qi up an ally's torn forearm until the bleeding slows and the wound closes.

name: Current Knot
description: Bind both of the opponent's arms in a knotted current of qi and strike the exposed ribs before it loosens.

name: Drag Current
description: Drag the opponent forward on a strong current of qi and meet the stumbling body with the elbow.

name: Undertow Palm
description: Strike low with a palm and pull the qi back as it lands so the target is dragged in after the blow.

name: Pull Guard
description: Pull an incoming wrist down and inward on a hidden draw of qi so the strike falls short.

name: Dive Slide
description: Sink the weight into the back leg and slide away along the ground as the rush arrives.

name: Backwash Strike
description: Swing the arm back in the wake of a block and drive a returning wash of qi into the attacker.

name: Salve Wash
description: Wash a wounded ally's burn or scrape with a cool sheet of water qi that calms the sting and speeds mending.

name: Dragging Undertow
description: Hook a hidden pull of water qi behind the opponent's knees and strike as the footing is lost.

name: Turning Undertow
description: Draw the opponent's force round the body on a curve of qi and send it back into the attacker.

name: Limpid Touch
description: Touch an ally's fevered brow with a palm of clear water qi to lower the heat and clear the head.

name: Rainwash Sense
description: Run a thin wash of qi over an ally's skin to read where the body holds poison or hidden hurt.

name: Purge Palm
description: Drive a palm into the belly so water qi churns the target's wind out in a single gasp.

name: Rain Guard
description: Let a fine sheet of rain-like qi fall round the washer so thrown grit and sparks cannot reach the skin.

name: Sluice Step
description: Slide aside through a channel of water qi opened under the feet and close it again behind the body.

name: Clean Strike
description: Hit the target's guard with a straight blow that leaves no wasted qi and no opening behind it.

name: Cleansing Flow
description: Pass a steady flow of water qi through an ally's blood to carry out a weak poison or a minor taint.

name: Rinsing Tide
description: Flush a fouled wound with a rising tide of qi that lifts the corruption out and seals the clean flesh.

name: Clearing Rain
description: Let a brief rain of water qi fall on an ally and wash off a clinging curse or binding residue.

name: Whirl Palm
description: Turn the whole body in a tight ring and strike with the palm at the end of the turn.

name: Weave Ward
description: Weave both hands in small rings before the chest so blows are turned off one after another.

name: Spin Step
description: Spin on the ball of the foot with water qi easing the pivot and end facing a new line.

name: Ring Wrap
description: Spin a ring of water qi around a punching arm and tighten it until the elbow cannot bend.

name: Swirl Strike
description: Strike with the forearm in a swirling arc that wraps the target's guard and hits behind it.

name: Round Salve
description: Circle a hand over an ally's bruise and let rings of water qi draw the swelling out into the air.

name: Whirling Pull
description: Wind the opponent into a spinning pull of qi and strike the turning back before balance returns.

name: Weaving Shroud
description: Keep rings of water qi turning round the body so each strike is combed aside by a moving shroud.

name: Press Palm
description: Set the palm on the target's chest and lean the whole body's weight through it with steady water qi.

name: Tide Guard
description: Plant the stance and let a heavy tide of qi rise round the arms to meet a strike.

name: Tide Step
description: Advance one pace with the whole frame moving together as a rising tide moves.

name: Drowning Weight
description: Let the body's weight fall into a downward palm with water qi adding mass to the blow.

name: Tide Lift
description: Lift an ally's flagging reserve with a rising tide of qi laid against the small of the back.

name: Pressing Tide
description: Press a heavy tide of water qi down on the opponent so the blow lands and the opponent's own qi sinks.

name: Tide Hold
description: Hold a standing tide of qi against the body while each strike that meets it is shoved back.

name: Humid Read
description: Breathe in and read the damp of the air to learn how many bodies share the room.

name: Trace Listen
description: Touch the wet print of a footstep and read from the water qi left in it how long ago it was made.

name: Echo Drop
description: Let a drop of qi fall into still water and read the echo for hidden shapes below.

name: Sodden Palm
description: Strike with a palm heavy with water qi so the blow lands like a soaked cloth.

name: Sheet Ward
description: Draw a thin sheet of water qi across the front of the body to catch a thrown missile.

name: Skimming Glide
description: Skim across a wet floor or a still surface in three light steps with qi under each sole.

name: Dowse Hand
description: Hold an open hand over the ground and feel hidden water qi pull toward it to find a buried cache.

name: Depth Sounding
description: Send a long pulse of water qi through the floor and walls and read the shape of every body it meets.

name: Far Ripple
description: Cast a spreading ripple ahead and follow its returns safely round the unseen corner.

name: Tracing Current
description: Loose a thin current of qi that seeks the target by its wet trail and strikes where it finds it.

name: Draught Palm
description: Drive the palm out with a full draught of qi behind it so the whole arm rings at the strike.

name: Slow Gulp
description: Offer an ally a swallow of qi-rich water that fills the chest and restores wind for another round.

name: Thirst Drain
description: Dry the opponent's mouth and throat with a pulling touch so the next shout comes out cracked.

name: Calm Pour
description: Pour a calm stream of qi over an ally's shaking hands and let it soothe the strained tendons.

name: Sink Guard
description: Sink low behind a heavy skin of water qi so a strike glides over the top of the shoulders.

name: Wade Step
description: Take a long slow stride that carries the body through a crowd on a parting wave of qi.

name: Deep Draught
description: Pass a long deep draught of water qi to an ally to restore reserve and ease the aches of battle.

name: Quenching Draught
description: Give an ally a draught that quenches a burning poison and cools the wounded vein.
